output.recommendation: Adopting a local vendor model for critical telecom networks' AI-driven operations and ensuring logs are hosted within the country would facilitate easier rollback of faulty models, aligning with EU-AIACT-2024 Article 12(1) which mandates technical recording of events over the system's lifetime to support traceability.
output.rationale: [G1] emphasizes the importance of logging for high-risk AI systems to ensure traceability and compliance. By following this recommendation, telecom operators can better manage their AI-driven operations within their borders, enhancing both security and operational efficiency.
